articles.summary: The six statements in this episode point in one direction. HR data is becoming the input for business decisions, and the quality of that input is decided in payroll. Three things follow. First, treat payroll accuracy as a trust question rather than a compliance question. Employees check it every month and conclude the rest of the company from what they find. Second, stop shopping for global payroll. Buy country-level depth with one accountable owner across markets. The rules are national, and they will stay national. Third, judge any system on whether it puts every market on one screen. If the answer to "what are we spending on people" takes three weeks to assemble, you do not have a reporting problem. You have a structural one.
articles.title: Your Workforce Decisions Are Only as Good as Your Payroll Data

articles.summary: For many employers, the end of the year brings an important payroll question: Do we need to pay a 13th month salary? The answer depends on where your employees are based, what their employment contracts say, and the payroll rules in that country. Here’s what African employers need to know.
articles.title: A Guide to 13th Month Pay for African Employers

articles.title: Case study: How Sinapis Cut Multi-Country Payroll From a Full Day to Five Minutes

articles.summary: Expanding your business into new African markets is a massive milestone. Whether you are scaling a fintech startup into Nigeria, building a regional hub in Kenya, or entering South Africa's thriving tech ecosystem, the growth potential is undeniable.
articles.title: Hiring Across Africa? Why Worker Misclassification is the Expense That Catches Founders Off Guard

articles.summary: Your payslip is more than a breakdown of what you earned this month. It shows how your gross salary becomes your net pay, what has been deducted, and, in many cases, what your employer is contributing on your behalf.But payroll terminology can be confusing, especially when working across different African countries.Here’s how to read your payslip and understand where your money goes.
articles.title: Understanding Your African Payslip: A Simple Guide to Salary, Taxes and Payroll Deductions

articles.summary: Every HR and finance team is being sold the same promise this year: point AI at the admin and the admin disappears.Payroll looks like the obvious place to start. Numbers in, numbers out, the same job every month. It is also the place where that assumption breaks fastest.In Episode 6 of the Workpay podcast, Paul and Jackson worked through six statements about AI and the future of work with Thomas Otter, venture capitalist at Acadian Ventures. What came out is a more useful position than either the hype or the backlash: AI is worth the investment, and it will only pay off on top of a process that already works.
articles.title: AI Will Not Fix Your Payroll. It Will Scale Whatever You Already Have
